# 3 bed end of terrace house for sale

> BROE auctioneers welcomes you to 65 Walkinstown Park set in a cosy cul de sac location. Although in need of light modernisation one of the many features is the magnificent private west facing rear garden and large front garden offering exceptional outdoor space. The accommodation includes entrance hallway that leads to a lounge, which connects to a kitchen/dining room and main bathroom.
